nodes.label: Vusic (Feishin Mobile)
nodes.rationale: Personal Android music player for a self-hosted Navidrome server over Subsonic/OpenSubsonic; personal use, no Play Store.

nodes.label: Subsonic/OpenSubsonic API
nodes.rationale: Token auth u/t/s/v/c/f=json with fresh salt per request; plain password never sent.

nodes.label: Lyrics
nodes.rationale: Added lang field so selection can prefer lyrics in the app/device language.

nodes.label: LyricsSelection
nodes.rationale: Order: synced in device language, any synced, unsynced in device language, first available; blank/"xxx" lang treated as matching any language.

nodes.label: StructuredLyricsDto
nodes.rationale: OpenSubsonic structured lyrics track from getLyricsBySongId; added because the server returns structuredLyrics rather than the legacy syncedLyrics/plainLyrics fields.

nodes.label: NavidromeLyricsProvider
nodes.rationale: Checks songLyrics OpenSubsonic extension, prefers structuredLyrics, falls back to legacy syncedLyrics/plainLyrics then legacy getLyrics with LRC parsing.

nodes.label: LyricsViewModel
nodes.rationale: Cache-first lyrics lookup backed by Room lyrics_cache.

nodes.label: MusicDatabase (Room)
nodes.rationale: lyrics_cache table added via migration 5->6 with an instrumented migration test.

nodes.label: RedactingHttpLogger
nodes.rationale: ENABLED is a compile-time constant tied to BuildConfig.DEBUG so logging is stripped from release builds.

nodes.label: Device Files (local playback)
nodes.rationale: Least-privilege audio permission (READ_MEDIA_AUDIO / READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE maxSdk 32); never asks for all-files access.

nodes.label: DeviceFilesViewModel
nodes.rationale: MediaStore query runs off the main thread with tag fallbacks.

nodes.label: PlayerManager
nodes.rationale: Owns one ExoPlayer and drives a MediaController, exposing StateFlows; app-side shuffle permutes only the upcoming tail so visible order matches playback.

nodes.label: PlayerService (MediaSessionService)
nodes.rationale: Foreground mediaPlayback service exposing the player via MediaSession for notification, lock-screen, Bluetooth and audio focus.

nodes.label: QueueStore
nodes.rationale: DataStore persistence of the queue including localUri for mixed local/stream queues.

nodes.label: Track
nodes.rationale: localUri added so device files play via content URI.

nodes.label: DownloadWorker
nodes.rationale: Room progress writes throttled to ~2/s and notifications ~1/s because per-chunk writes caused thousands of Room invalidations and visible jank.

nodes.label: MessageHost
nodes.rationale: Placed after MiniPlayer in the NavHost Box so snackbars paint above the floating mini player instead of underneath it.

nodes.label: Nav.kt (NavHost)
nodes.rationale: Single NavHost whose start destination reacts to login state, so no restart is needed.

nodes.label: LoginScreen
nodes.rationale: Failed connect never resets the form; inline themed error card plus snackbar with specific messages.

nodes.label: MusicRepository
nodes.rationale: Cache-first reads with background revalidation; playlist updates batched at 100 song IDs per request.

nodes.label: MetadataCache
nodes.rationale: Serves cache-first and decodes on Dispatchers.IO to remove multi-second cold-start waits.

nodes.label: CachePolicy
nodes.rationale: Per-key throttle ~3 min, one-shot force per pull-to-refresh, and a failed attempt still consumes its window.

nodes.label: SettingsStore (DataStore)
nodes.rationale: DataStore key dynamic_np_color kept unchanged when the feature was renamed to Dynamic Theme.

nodes.label: app/build.gradle.kts
nodes.rationale: resConfigs("en") strips ~85 library locales; ABI splits ship arm64-v8a and x86_64 only; release signing falls back to debug config when the keystore is absent so CI still produces an installable APK.

nodes.label: Phase 9 (synced lyrics, device files, Dynamic Theme rename, 1.2.0)
nodes.rationale: Three sections, one commit each, version bumped to 1.2.0 / versionCode 8.

nodes.label: Phase 8.4 (messages, download perf, artist-to-playlist, login errors, 1.1.4)
nodes.rationale: Four sections, one commit each, version bumped to 1.1.4 / versionCode 7.

nodes.label: Phase 9 (v1.2.0)
nodes.rationale: Big update combining synced lyrics, device files and a settings rename; one commit per section.

nodes.label: P9-A: Synced Lyrics
nodes.rationale: LRCLIB first with song-metadata fallback; UI must never block on network.

nodes.label: P9-B: Device Files
nodes.rationale: Opt-in MediaStore browsing with least-privilege audio permission; off by default so existing installs are unchanged.

nodes.label: P9-C: Dynamic Theme Label Rename
nodes.rationale: Keep the same DataStore key so existing users keep their choice.

nodes.label: Lyrics Pipeline (cache -> LRCLIB -> metadata)
nodes.rationale: Cache hit first for instant display; upgrade rule prefers synced metadata over plain LRCLIB.

nodes.label: LyricsProvider interface
nodes.rationale: Single interface so all sources (LRCLIB, Navidrome, FileTags) are interchangeable.

nodes.label: LyricsRepository
nodes.rationale: Implements the A1 pipeline ordering and caching rules.

nodes.label: LRCLIB LyricsProvider
nodes.rationale: Sends only title, artist, album and duration for privacy; max ~4 requests per song.

nodes.label: NavidromeLyricsProvider
nodes.rationale: Prioritizes OpenSubsonic structuredLyrics, falls back to syncedLyrics/plainLyrics.

nodes.label: FileTags LyricsProvider
nodes.rationale: Reads embedded ID3v2 USLT/SYLT, Vorbis/FLAC LYRICS, MP4 ©lyr; no sidecar .lrc files.

nodes.label: LyricsSelection
nodes.rationale: Language-aware selection prioritizing synced lyrics matching device/app language.

nodes.label: StructuredLyricsDto
nodes.rationale: Models the modern OpenSubsonic structuredLyrics array from getLyricsBySongId.

nodes.label: OpenSubsonic getLyricsBySongId
nodes.rationale: Requires the songLyrics extension advertised via getOpenSubsonicExtensions.

nodes.label: Legacy Subsonic getLyrics
nodes.rationale: Plain-text unsynced fallback when the songLyrics extension is missing.

nodes.label: Room lyrics_cache table (migration 5->6)
nodes.rationale: Negative results cached with ~7 day expiry; network failures not cached as 'nothing found'.

nodes.label: MusicDatabase (Room, schema v6)
nodes.rationale: Any schema change needs a Room migration and migration test, never destructive fallback.

nodes.label: Lyrics Sync Engine
nodes.rationale: Binary search on sorted line times; recompute only on line-boundary crossing or seek; runs only while Lyrics tab visible and app foregrounded.

nodes.label: Lyrics Settings Section
nodes.rationale: Stored in DataStore and applied live to an open Lyrics tab.

nodes.label: MediaStore Audio
nodes.rationale: IS_MUSIC filter excluding ringtones/alarms/notifications; ContentObserver for live updates.

nodes.label: READ_MEDIA_AUDIO / READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permission
nodes.rationale: Least-privilege audio permission; MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE explicitly forbidden.

nodes.label: 'View my' Library Bottom Sheet
nodes.rationale: Chevron only appears when Show device files is enabled.

nodes.label: MessageHost snackbar architecture
nodes.rationale: Floats above mini player, bottom nav or keyboard.

nodes.label: MetadataCache
nodes.rationale: Stale-while-revalidate library caching.

nodes.label: EncryptedSharedPreferences (Subsonic credentials)
nodes.rationale: Non-plain-text credentials; token auth with fresh salt per request.

nodes.label: Android Auto service
nodes.rationale: Device files not added to the browse tree in this phase.

nodes.label: docs/reference/phase9/ reference screenshots
nodes.rationale: Behavior and layout references only (YouTube Music, Metrolist); do not copy code, names or assets.

nodes.label: gradle-run skill
nodes.rationale: All agent-initiated Gradle commands must go through the compact-output wrapper; never raw ./gradlew.

nodes.label: jetpack-compose-performance skill
nodes.author: Google LLC
nodes.rationale: Mandatory reference read before flagging or editing Compose performance issues.

nodes.label: compose-performance skill
nodes.rationale: Measure one user-visible transition, identify the runtime axis, apply the smallest correction.

nodes.label: compose-state-and-effects skill
nodes.rationale: Give every piece of UI state one lowest responsible owner.

nodes.label: compose-animations skill
nodes.rationale: Pick the smallest animation API that expresses the motion and its lifecycle.

nodes.label: kotlin-concurrency-and-flow skill
nodes.rationale: Give asynchronous work an explicit owner and lifetime.

nodes.label: token-efficiency skill
nodes.rationale: Optimize total cost and time to a verified result.

nodes.label: Android Permissions and IPC Security Skill
nodes.author: Google LLC

nodes.label: CallerVerifier
nodes.rationale: Intent extras and string package names are forged by malicious applications, so caller identity must be authenticated cryptographically via Binder.getCallingUid() and certificate hashes.

nodes.label: SecureBoundService
nodes.rationale: checkCallingOrSelfPermission falls back to the host app UID outside IPC or when identity is cleared, granting access and causing a Confused Deputy bypass; enforceCallingPermission avoids this.

nodes.label: RuntimePermissionsActivity
nodes.rationale: Implements a 3-state flow (granted, rationale, launch contract) without caching states or infinite retry loops.

nodes.label: UriPermissionManager
nodes.rationale: Runtime UriPermission tokens provide least-privilege per-URI sharing instead of broad manifest grants.

nodes.label: ProtectedReceiver
nodes.rationale: Validates sentFromPackage on Android 14+ to reject unauthorized broadcast senders.

nodes.label: SecureDataProvider
nodes.rationale: Split read/write permissions with signature protection level prevent read-only callers from executing writes and vice versa.

nodes.label: Compose component design skill
nodes.rationale: Components own invariant structure while callers retain placement, content, and policy choices that vary by use.

nodes.label: Compose focus navigation skill
nodes.rationale: Focus is stateful UI behavior: make targets and exceptional edges explicit, then drive and verify through user input.

nodes.label: Emil Kowalski Design Engineering skill
nodes.author: Emil Kowalski
nodes.rationale: Unseen details compound; taste is trained, not innate, and beauty is leverage.

nodes.label: CircuitBreaker
nodes.rationale: Prevents cascading failures in distributed systems by rejecting requests while open and probing recovery in half-open state.

nodes.label: ErrorCollector
nodes.rationale: Collects multiple errors instead of failing on first error, enabling full validation feedback.

nodes.label: retry decorator
nodes.rationale: Retries with exponential backoff to handle transient recoverable errors.

nodes.label: with_fallback
nodes.rationale: Graceful degradation: try primary function, fall back on error.

nodes.label: Animation Decision Framework
nodes.author: Emil Kowalski
nodes.rationale: Frequency, purpose, easing, and duration determine whether and how to animate; never animate keyboard-initiated actions.

nodes.label: Spring Animations
nodes.author: Emil Kowalski
nodes.rationale: Springs simulate real physics and maintain velocity when interrupted, unlike CSS keyframes which restart from zero.

nodes.label: clip-path for Animation
nodes.author: Emil Kowalski
nodes.rationale: clip-path inset enables seamless color transitions, hold-to-delete, image reveals, and comparison sliders without extra DOM.
